schema_doc: PRD-014 / RFC-017 — surface-hotspot tier metadata sidecar. Joins to moon-sites.json + mars-sites.json by site id. Sites without an entry render Tier 0 only (silhouette via existing moon-lander-models.ts / mars-lander-models.ts dispatcher). Sites with hotspot_tier_max >= 1 get progressive LOD via the hotspot dispatcher.
